newsitem.title: JAPAN: US Treasury's Summers to meet Mitsuzuka on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's Summers to meet Mitsuzuka on Tuesday.

text.p: A U.S. embassy spokesman confirmed on Monday that U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers would meet Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka on Tuesday.

Summers, who will be in Tokyo for the so-called "Six Markets Meeting" of senior finance and central bank officials from the United States, Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, China and Australia, will also meet Takatoshi Kato, vice finance minister for international affairs, and Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, the spokesman confirmed.
The U.S. embassy spokesman declined to specify the time of Summers's meetings with the Japanese officials.

Mitsuzuka must attend a regular cabinet ministers' meeting, usually held around 9 a.m. (0000 GMT). He must also attend a session of the Lower House's finance committee from 10 a.m. to 11.30 a.m. (0100 GMT to 0230 GMT).
Mitsuzuka will not attend the "Six Markets Meeting" at which Japan will be represented by Kato and Bank of Japan Deputy Governor for International Relations Akira Nagashima.
